device_identification.what_it_is: Rectangular spiral waveguide delay line (paperclip/racetrack spiral). A single continuous single-mode waveguide wound as ~6 nested rounded-rectangle loops with a tall central ∩-shaped U-turn 'hook' near the center-left. Used to realize a long, compact optical path length (group delay / phase accumulation / a long interferometer arm) in a small footprint.
device_identification.how_it_works: Light enters, travels the full wound length accumulating optical path length L_opt = n_eff * L_phys (~2.66 mm here), then exits. It is an in-and-out spiral: the outer arm spirals inward, a central hook reverses direction, and an inner return arm (two full-width bottom straights joined by a right-end U) carries the guide back out. Interleaving/nesting is why the visible tracks appear as symmetric top/bottom pairs about the vertical center. Minimum bend radius (hook, corner rounding) sets the bend-loss floor; track pitch sets crosstalk between adjacent guides.
function_defining_knobs: wg_width_um (0.65): single-mode waveguide width -> n_eff, loss
pitch_um (3.00): center-to-center spacing between adjacent tracks -> crosstalk, packing density
n_loops (6): number of wound loops -> primary control of total path length (delay)
corner_radius_top_um / corner_radius_bot_um: rectangular-turn bend radii -> bend loss (bottom/seam corners are measurably tighter)
hook_corner_um / right_u_radius_um: central bulb-hook and return-U bend radii -> min-bend bend-loss floor
lead_in_um: input access-waveguide length -> linear (1:1) control of the total optical path length / delay
outer_half_width_um / outer_half_height_um: footprint of the outermost loop

measurements_from_image.structure: 6 symmetric nested rounded-rectangle loops (top/bottom track centers pair about y-center) + a tall central ∩-bulb hook (left wall x=-68.6um, right wall x=-48.5um, apex y=+11.8um) feeding two inner return straights at b_inner+pitch and b_inner+2*pitch, joined by a right-end U.
measurements_from_image.key_finding: Corner radius ~constant ~6um for top/left corners but the bottom-right (spiral-seam) corners are tighter (~4um); rasterized set-radius must be ~1.35x the target effective radius to match after the thick-line/shallow-arc rendering bias.

build_approach: Primitives only: a single gf.Path centerline for the loop bank (per-vertex circular fillet with independent top/bottom radii), a second gf.Path for the ∩-bulb hook, and a smooth() arc for the return U — each extruded on a width=0.65um layer-(1,0) CrossSection. No gf.components stencils, no raw polygons.

iterations.change_made: Initial concentric inward rectangular spiral (constant corner radius, no inner arm), circular arc bends; identified device as spiral delay line.
Removed the out-of-footprint port tail so device bbox = footprint (173.5x59.5); tracks stopped shifting outward.
Added the inner return arm (two full-width bottom straights) that the target has and my single spiral lacked.
Tuned pitch to 3.00um (sharp optimum; tracks aligned within 1px across all 6 loops).
Per-vertex fillet with corner set-radius ~8um (renders to measured ~6um); corners were the dominant error. Rebuilt the central hook as the true tall ∩-bulb.
Gave top vs bottom-right corners independent radii (target seam corners ~4um vs ~6um). Final: precision 0.769, recall 0.961.

final.note: Honest best over 6 refinement iterations. Recall 0.96 => nearly all target material is reproduced; the residual (precision 0.77) is sub-pixel registration at the ~4um tight seam corners of a very fine 3um-pitch / 0.65um-line structure, where a 1px offset roughly halves per-line overlap. IoU 0.746 < 0.85 stop threshold reflects that pixel-exact corner registration on this fine spiral is at the limit of hand-tuned parametric fitting, not a topology error.

knob_verification.note: Tool is MZI-shaped (needs a 2-arm lengths.json + a 1:1 length knob). For this delay line the two 'arms' are the wound optical path vs the straight port-to-port reference, so delta_length_um = the excess path = the delay the device adds. lead_in_um is the linear delay knob and passes both checks. The primary topology knobs also move real geometry (uncached builders): n_loops 6->7 changes loop path length 2359->2669um; pitch 3.0->3.3 changes it 2359->2323um.
